requirements.text: Patients should be able to book, change, or cancel appointments online.
Patients should have a straightforward way to request repeat prescriptions.
Patients should only see test results after a doctor has reviewed them, with a notification system to inform them when results are ready.
There should be a secure login process to verify patient identities before accessing personal information.
The system must comply with regulations regarding patient data privacy and security.
The system should be user-friendly for clinic staff, minimizing complications in learning to use it.
